# Josh Wright

> Josh Wright is a technical artist, software developer and AI engineer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at Arizona State University in May 2027. He builds animation tools for Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine and Cinema 4D, trains and fine-tunes models and writes CUDA. At Pixel Pirate Studio he made the markerless motion capture pipeline 2.8x faster at the same accuracy, and he trained a Battlecode bot on 6 million game turns mined from 110,000 ladder matches.

Looking for: New grad roles starting May 2027 in technical art, software development and AI engineering: animation tools and plugins, pipeline work, model training and fine-tuning, GPU and CUDA work, reinforcement learning and computer vision, especially at game and animation studios.
Contact: joshwright0322@gmail.com

## Projects

- [UNOMi](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/unomi/): 2.8x faster motion capture, same accuracy
- [nanoTSFM Forecasting](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/nanotsfm-forecasting/): Set record 4 on the nanoTSFM leaderboard
- [Trust No One](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/trust-no-one/): Placed #9 of 2,253 games
- [Cambridge Battlecode 2026](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/cambridge-battlecode-2026/): Mined 110,000 ladder matches, trained on 6M turns
- [There's No Place Like 127.0.0.1](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/theres-no-place-like-127-0-0-1/): Highest scored pitch at the AZ Game Cup
- [3D Animation Reel](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/3d-animation-reel/): TV quality animation
- [Game Dev Club Club](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/game-dev-club-club/): Created a club across 104 universities
- [AtOMoC SHeLiS](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/atomoc-shelis/): Placed #12 of 150 games
- [Gob Spin](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/gob-spin/): Placed #140 of 3,498 games
- [Slush Rush](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/slush-rush/): Placed #69 of 434 games
